Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The umpires and players make their way out in the middle. Litton Das and Rony Talukdar will open the innings for Bangladesh. Sam Curran will start the proceedings with the ball for England. Let's play...
... CHASE TIME ...

Right then, England will be a bit disappointed with their batting effort towards the end but Jos Buttler will be confident enough that his bowlers can defend this total. On the other hand, Bangladesh have momentum with them but they have a tricky target to overhaul. Will their batters rise to the challenge? We shall find out shortly. Back in a bit for the chase.

Despite Shakib Al Hasan winning the toss and opting to bowl first, Bangladesh were unable to start well, conceding 51 runs in the Powerplay. Moreover, the two dropped catches did not help their case either. They did manage to dismiss Philip Salt in the 10th over but they were unable to keep Jos Buttler and Ben Duckett quiet. However, they clawed their way back into the game by dismissing both batters in quick succession. They kept the pressure on the incoming batters and never allowed England to gain any momentum in the death overs.

This has been a good fightback by Bangladesh and they have done well to keep England below 160. After England were sent into bat, the opening pair of Philip Salt and Jos Buttler got them off to a flying start in the Powerplay. Despite the departure of his partner near the halfway mark, Jos Buttler kept going and stitched a quickfire 47-run stand with Ben Duckett. The visitors were pegged back after losing both set batters on consecutive deliveries and lost their way with the bat. As a result, they were unable to maximize towards the backend of the innings.

A fantastic attempt. Slower one, short and around off, Moeen stands back and hammers it towards wide long on. Shanto takes the catch near the fence and then tosses it up as he goes beyond the fence. The fielder from deep mid-wicket is in the vicinity and he tries to catch it with a dive. The ball though spills out and the batters take two runs. England end on 156 for 6.
Back of a length, around off, Moeen pulls it in front of square on the leg side. Nasum Ahmed does well in the deep and they get a couple.
Short and on off, Chris pulls it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
FOUR! A boundary at last for England. A low full toss around off, Jordan squeezes it out past backward point for a boundary. 150 comes up!
Play and a miss! Short in length and outside off, at 138 kph, Jordan tries to pull but misses.
Chris Jordan walks out to bat.

OUT! Sound of timber! England have lost the plot in the end overs. Taskin lets out a smart variation. Deception at its very best. Serves it on a length, around middle at 101.6 kph, Woakes clears his front leg for a big heave-ho across the line but is way too early into the shot. He misses and the leg stump takes a beating.
Taskin Ahmed will bowl the final over. He has figures of 3-0-26-0 so far.
Inswinging yorker around middle, Woakes bunts it down to long on for a run. A couple of very impressive overs from Hasan Mahmud at the backend and his spell comes to an end. 2 for 26.
Chris Woakes comes in at number 7.

OUT! Curran is caught! Mahmud delivers a slower one, short and outside off at 108.9 kph, Sam tries to power it across the line but only manages to loft it towards long on. A simple catch for Najmul Hossain Shanto and Bangladesh are finishing strongly here.
Commentary.Howout: c Najmul Hossain Shanto b Hasan Mahmud

Commentary.Commentary: Swing and a miss, and it's a dot. Lovely bowling from the young man. Full and around off, angling across, Sam tries to heave but misses.
Slower length ball, on off, Moeen plays a mistimed shot to extra cover. They cross. Shakib takes aim and has a shy but misses. This time they don't go for the overthrow.
Into the blockhole, Curran drags it down to long on for a single.
Around leg, Moeen steps back and drives it straight to extra cover. Shakib has a needless shy at the bowler's end and misses. They cross for an overthrow.
A low full toss on middle, Curran drills it down the ground. The fielder from long on makes a sliding stop and does a relay with the long off fielder. Two runs.
Goes short around off, offering no pace, Moeen plays a reactive pull shot behind square leg. They cross.
Nearly chops it on. Slower length ball on off, Moeen goes for a big pull across the line but gets an inside edge. The ball beats the stumps and rolls to the right of the keeper.
Angles in a length ball on off, Curran pushes it gently to extra cover and rotates the strike.
Angles in a length ball, around middle, Moeen moves back and steers it through cover-point for a single.
Around off, on a length, from 'round the wicket, Sam taps it down to backward point for a single.
Wide! Attempted a slower one but it's down the leg side. Curran doesn't get any touch behind it.
Slower one, on a length outside off, Curran strokes it to sweeper cover for a single. Top over from Hasan Mahmud!
Fuller and around middle, it's pushed back to the bowler. What an over from Hasan, so far.
On a length outside off, Curran cuts but finds point.

Shout for a run out! A near-yorker on middle, Sam digs it out back to the bowler. Hasan stretches his right hand out and gets a bit of touch. The ball goes behind to rattle the sticks and the Bangla players appeal. The third umpire is referred and the replays find that Moeen is safely in.
Bowls it full and outside off, Curran drives but finds the fielder at mid off.
Sam Curran is the new man in for England.

OUT! Buttler holes out and Bangladesh have picked back-to-back wickets. This is not ideal if you are an England fan. Both set batters are dismissed at the backend. Fuller and around off, angling in, Jos clears his front leg for a big heave across the line but it takes the toe end. The ball flies to long on where Najmul Hossain Shanto collects the catch by going down low. A good phase of play for the home team. Can they finish strongly?
Commentary.Howout: c Najmul Hossain Shanto b Hasan Mahmud

Commentary.Commentary: OUT! Bowled 'em! Mustafizur goes pace up this time. Delivers it a bit short around off, at 132.5 kph and it stays a bit low as well. Ben Duckett hangs on the back foot to pull it across the line but fails to connect. It perhaps brushes his thigh pad before going on to uproot the off stump. A quickfire 47-run stand comes to a close.
Moeen Ali walks out to the middle. Also, Hasan Mahmud (2-0-21-0) returns to the attack.
Wide! The Fizz attempts for a wide yorker but ends up bowling a low full toss way outside off.
Slower bouncer, around off, Jos delays his shot and pulls it to deep square leg. Only a run this time.
A low full toss around leg, Buttler clips it behind square leg and rushes back for the second run.
Mustafizur Rahman goes short and slow, around off, Duckett drags his pull to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Superb innovation. Mustafizur Rahman delivers a length ball in the line of the stumps, Ben Duckett shuffles across the stumps and spoons it behind the keeper for a boundary.
Width there, short and outside off, Ben cuts but finds point.
Change in bowling. Mustafizur Rahman comes back to bowl at the death. 2-0-18-0 are his figures so far.
Slower and into the wicket outside off, Jos Buttler goes for the pull but plays it a bit early and does not get any bat on it. 11 from the over!
On a length at the pads, Ben Duckett helps this one down to fine leg and takes a single.
Slower and full, on off, Jos Buttler gets deceived by the pace of the delivery but still manages to swat this one to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Thrashed! Taskin Ahmed misses his length and ends up bowling a low full toss outside off, Jos Buttler does not miss out as he smashes this one over extra cover for a boundary.
Keeps it full and on off, Ben Duckett drives it along the ground to mid off for a single.

FOUR! Smart batting by Ben Duckett! Taskin Ahmed bowls this one full and outside off, Ben Duckett moves to the off side and uses the pace of the delivery. Scoops this one over the keeper's head for a boundary.
Taskin Ahmed (2-0-15-0) comes back into the attack.
Full and on off by Shakib Al Hasan, Ben Duckett gets down and sweeps it to deep square leg for a single. 9 from the over, Shakib is done with his 4-over spell, 1 for 26.

FOUR! Superb execution. Floated delivery, full and on off, Ben Duckett lunges and sweeps it on top of the bounce. Gets it away from the middle of the bat and the ball races past the square leg umpire for a boundary.
Loopy and full, on middle, Buttler wrists it through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, full around off, Jos Buttler drives this one to extra cover for a dot.
Short and on leg, Jos Buttler helps this one towards fine leg. A fumble there allows Buttler to return for the second run.
Full and on Ben Duckett sweeps this one to deep square leg for a single.

SIX! Back-to-back sixes for Jos Buttler! 17 from the over. Hasan Mahmud shortens his length and bowls it on middle, Jos Buttler makes room and pulls this one well over deep mid-wicket for yet another maximum. FIFTY FOR JOS!
SIX! Jos Buttler goes huge! Full and on leg by Hasan Mahmud, Jos Buttler clears his front leg and thumps this one down the ground for a maximum. 100 comes up!

Full and around off, Jos Buttler hoicks this one wide of long on and collects a couple of runs. The fielder there, Najmul Hossain Shanto, fires in a throw at the non-striker's end but does not hit. The replays show that Ben Duckett was gone had the fielder hit.
On a length, on off, Ben Duckett taps this one towards backward point and takes a single. Shamim Hossain there dives to his left and keeps it to one.

An appeal for LBW but turned down! Full and angling in on leg, Jos Buttler clears his front leg and goes for a big heave. But, he gets an inside edge that rolls in front of cover off his pads and the batters take a single.
Length delivery just outside off, Ben Duckett dabs this one off the back foot to deep point for a single.
Flighted, full on off, Ben Duckett plants his foot forward and knocks it down to long on for a single.
Ben Duckett is in next at number 4. He is a very good player of spin and loves his sweep and reverse sweep shots.

OUT! CAUGHT! Shakib Al Hasan comes back into the attack and removes Dawid Malan! Continues to keep it full and on off, Dawid Malan shimmies down the track and looks to go over long on. Does not get this one from the middle part of the bat to clear the fence and holes out to Najmul Hossain Shanto who takes a well-judged catch near the ropes.
Commentary.Howout: c Najmul Hossain Shanto b Shakib Al Hasan

Commentary.Commentary: Keeps it full and on middle, Jos Buttler leans forward and drives it down to long off for a single.
Fired in full and on off, Dawid Malan heaves this one to deep mid-wicket and collects another single.
Short and flatter at the stumps, Jos Buttler stays on the back foot and taps it towards extra cover for a run.
Fraction short and on middle and leg, Dawid Malan gets inside the line of the ball and sweeps this one to the left of deep square leg for a single.
Change in bowling. Shakib Al Hasan returns to deliver his third over.
Back of a length around off, Dawid Malan uses his feet and pulls it down to long on for a single. A tight first over by Hasan Mahmud.
Full and angling away outside off, Dawid Malan goes for the drive away from his body but misses.
Full and outside off by Hasan Mahmud, Jos Buttler shuffles across and flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Length delivery around off, Dawid Malan steers this one past backward point and opens his account with a single.
Full and at the stumps, Dawid Malan gets behind the line and defends it to extra cover.
Starts with a full delivery on middle, Jos Buttler knocks this one down to long on for a single.

Drinks! Despite losing Philip Salt just before the Drinks break, England are off to a fine start here. Jos Buttler is looking in complete control at the moment and with plenty of batting still to come, he will look to press on the accelerator. With still 10 overs remaining, these are ominous signs for Bangladesh and the two dropped catches have made matters worse for them. They will be relieved to see the back of Philip Salt and will look to squeeze in a couple of quiet overs. Also, Dawid Malan comes in at number 3 for England. Hasan Mahmud to bowl after the break.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Nasum Ahmed gets a wicket on the final ball of his 4-over spell. Serves it short and around off, it skids on after landing, Philip Salt goes back to pull but fails to connect. Litton Das does well to collect the ball and they appeal. The finger has gone up and Salt decides to take the DRS. The UltraEdge finds a spike. Philip Salt is in disbelief as he returns. A good knock from him, although a bit on the slower side.
Commentary.Howout: c Litton Das b Nasum Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: Caught behind check!
Given caught behind! Philip Salt has reviewed the decision...
Flatter on off, hit through the line but straight to Shakib at extra cover.
SIX! Gone the distance! Floated delivery, full and around off, Philip Salt advances down the track and muscles it behind the bowler's head for a biggie.
Loopy and full, around off, Buttler opens the face of his bat and drives it through point for a single.
FOUR! Fine execution! Floated and full, around off, Buttler brings out the reverse-batted shot and unfurls it through the gap between backward point and short third man.
Short and on off, forced down to long off for a single.
SIX! High and handsome! Shakib offers a good loop to this delivery, landing full and around off, Buttler gets the chance to free his arms and nails it over long on for a biggie.
Full and around leg, nudged through square leg for a single.
Quicker and on off, punched back to the bowler.
Senses the charge from the batter and follows him with a flatter full ball around leg, Salt mistimes his shot back to the bowler.
Flatter and shorter on middle, Salt goes back and punches but finds extra cover.
Fuller around leg, it's fired in, Buttler comes running down the track and hits it firmly to long on for a run.

A low full toss around off, Buttler goes for the reverse sweep but doesn't get the desired connection. It goes towards short third man and they take a run. Slow going from England, they are preserving wickets at the moment.
Darts it in, short and on middle, Salt pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Walks forward to a full ball and pushes it to long off for a single.
Edgy! Too full and around off, Salt slices his attempted drive and it goes towards short third man. They cross.
Turning away from around off, Buttler gets a soft leading edge while attempting the flick shot. The ball dribbles to cover-point and they steal a single.
Flatter and on off, Buttler strokes off the back foot to extra cover.
Short and on middle, staying low, Jos helps it behind square leg for another run. Four singles from the over.
Fuller and around off, this time Salt drives it past the left side of the bowler. It travels to long off and they cross.
Loopy and full, drifting in around off, Salt mistimes his drive back to the bowler.
Skidding into the batter from around off, this time Jos works it cleanly through the gap at mid-wicket for a single.
Arm ball on middle, Buttler stays back to flick but gets it away off the inner half to mid-wicket.
Quicker one around off, it's eased down to long off for a single.
Shakib Al Hasan brings himself into the attack. Can he make amends for that dropped catch?
Goes on the back foot and punches it to sweeper cover. A single to end the over and the Powerplay. England are 51 for 0.
FOUR! Bang! Rubbing salt. Short and around leg, skidding in, Salt steps back and powers it past the diving Shakib for a boundary at wide long on.

DROPPED! The second catch has been put down in this over and it's Shakib Al Hasan who is the culprit. Flighted and on middle, short in length, Buttler gets back to hit it over the off side but the ball spins away at the last moment. He ends up mistiming it in the air and Shakib Al Hasan drops a sitter at mid on. The batters cross.
Short and around middle, Jos punches from the back foot but finds extra cover.
Tossed up, around off, driven down to long off for a run.
Did it carry? Oh yes, it's dropped. Fuller and on off, Salt drives it uppishly back to the bowler. Nasum goes down low but fails to catch it. Tough chance but should have been taken at this level.
Change in bowling. Nasum Ahmed (1-0-7-0) to bowl the final over of the Powerplay.

SIX! BANG! The runs continue to flow for England! Bowls this one back of a length outside off, Jos Buttler gets the width he needs, clears his front leg and thumps it over well over long on for the first maximum of the game.
Back of a length on off, Philip Salt eases this one towards extra cover and takes a single.
Fuller and outside off, Jos Buttler reaches out to the delivery to go through the off side but gets it from the toe end of the bat. The ball rolls towards mid on and the batters cross for a single.
Back of a length on middle, Jos Buttler stays on the back foot and plays it back to the bowler.
Length delivery at the batter, Philip Salt gets cramped for room but still manages to work it towards mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Full and angling across outside off, Philip Salt frees his arms and drives this one past extra cover. Gets it to the left of long off and collects a boundary. Every over so far continues to have at least one boundary.
On a length, on off, Philip Salt pushes this one to mid off and takes a quick single. It's a safe start from England so far.
Goes full again and on off, Jos Buttler gets his bat down in time and drives this one to deep cover for a single.
Beaten! Back of a length around off, at 142.2 kph, Jos Buttler tries to work this one fine on the off side but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Fullish delivery outside off, Philip Salt squeezes this one to deep cover for a single.
Touch fuller outside off, Jos Buttler drives this one to covers and calls his partner for a quick single. A fumble there allows Philip Salt to make his ground at the striker's end with ease.

FOUR! Beautiful timing by Jos Buttler! Back of a length in the channel outside off, Jos Buttler gets on his toes and punches this one along the ground on the off side. Gets it through covers and collects a boundary.
Will we get to see another bowling change? Nopes. Shakib Al Hasan is continuing with Taskin Ahmed.
Keeps it on a length on off, Philip Salt can only push this one to extra cover. A tidy first over by Mustafizur Rahman.

Good-length delivery angling in on leg, Philip Salt looks to go through the off side but gets beaten by the sharp inward movement. It beats the inside edge and the keeper dives across to his left to collect the ball.
WIDE! Slower and into the wicket but down the leg side, Philip Salt tries to help it fine but misses and the umpire signals a wide.
Back of a length around off, Philip Salt punches this one down the wicket but Mustafizur Rahman sticks out his left hand in his followthrough and makes a sharp stop.
On a good length, on middle, Philip Salt clips this one straight to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Smashed by Philip Salt! Bowls a cutter, full and at the stumps, Philip Salt makes room and drills this one back past the bowler for a boundary at long off.
Starts with a full delivery angling across on off, Philip Salt gets forward and pushes it to mid off for a dot.
Mustafizur Rahman to bowl the third over.
Length delivery on middle, Philip Salt taps this one to point and retains the strike with a single.
On a length, on off, by Taskin Ahmed, Jos Buttler looks to work this one on the off side but gets an inside edge that rolls to mid on for a run.
Keeps it full and outside off, Jos Buttler drives but finds extra cover.
Length and around off, Philip Salt chops this one towards point and takes a single.

A loud appeal for LBW but turned down! Full and swinging in on leg, Philip Salt misses the flick and gets rapped on the front pad. The ball lobs off his pads towards point and the batters sneak in a single. The fielder fires a throw at the striker's end but does not hit and concedes an overthrow towards fine leg. Two leg byes in total.
FOUR! Nicely played! Taskin Ahmed starts with a length delivery on off, Philip Salt gets on top of the bounce and punches this one through covers for a boundary.
Taskin Ahmed to operate from the other end.
FOUR! Bowls this one full and on middle, Jos Buttler picks the length early and thumps this one over the bowler's head for his first boundary of the game.
Short and on off, Jos Buttler dabs this one to backward point for a dot.
Full and on middle, Philip Salt goes for the sweep but miscues this one off the under edge. It rolls behind square leg and they cross.

So close to the leg stump! Short and angled in on leg, Philip Salt makes room to go through the off side but misses. The ball sneaks past the leg stump and beats the keeper. The batters run two in the process.
Short and slower on off, Jos Buttler hangs back and pushes this one down to long off. Gets off the mark with a single as well.
Philip Salt and England are underway! Nasum Ahmed starts with a short delivery on off, Philip Salt goes back in his crease and punches it to long off for a single.
Time to get underway! The Bangladesh players are out in the middle and they are joined by the two English openers - Jos Buttler and Philip Salt.​ Nasum Ahmed to deliver the first over. Let's play...

Jos Buttler, the English captain, says that he has good experience in the squad and is looking forward to a good series. Mentions that he would have batted first anyway as it's a used surface. Adds that you have to play with a lot of freedom in T20s and informs that two players missing out are Rehan Ahmed and Reece Topley.

Shakib Al Hasan, the captain of Bangladesh, says that they are not sure what a good score will be so they are happy to let England bat first. Feels that they have to play with a lot of freedom in this format and informs that a lot of boys who fared well in the BPL are included in the squad. Tells that Towhid Hridoy is making his debut. Agrees that they have to assess the wicket and bowl accordingly.

Pitch report - The surface here at the Zahur Ahmed Chowdhury Stadium is the same that was used for the final ODI. There are a lot of cracks and the bowlers will need to bowl cutters into the surface. The wicket will provide assistance to the spinners but not as much as it did in the last game. Looks like a top surface and runs on the board will be handy.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Rony Talukdar, Najmul Hossain Shanto, Litton Das (WK), Shakib Al Hasan (C), Towhid Hridoy (On T20I debut), Afif Hossain, Shamim Hossain, Taskin Ahmed, Nasum Ahmed, Hasan Mahmud, Mustafizur Rahman.
England (Playing XI) - Philip Salt, Jos Buttler (C/WK), Dawid Malan, Ben Duckett, Moeen Ali, Sam Curran, Chris Woakes, Chris Jordan, Adil Rashid, Jofra Archer, Mark Wood.
TOSS - The coin toss lands in the favour of Bangladesh and they have opted to BOWL first.

On the other hand, England will continue to be led by their white-ball skipper Jos Buttler. Having clinched the ODI series, the visitors will be now eyeing to bag the T20I series as well. The reigning world T20 champions are missing some of their key players but are still a solid unit. Which team will draw first blood in the series? Let's find out. Toss and team news coming up shortly...

The change in format has brought about a change in leadership for Bangladesh with Shakib Al Hasan leading the hosts. Having managed to avoid a whitewash in the ODI series by securing a win in the third ODI, the hosts will be looking to extend that momentum with the addition of fresh faces to their side for the T20I series.

Hello and a warm welcome, ladies and gentlemen, to our coverage of the 1st T20I between Bangladesh and England at the Zahur Ahmed Chowdhury Stadium in Chattogram. After a tightly contested ODI series, it is now time for both teams to lock horns in a three-match T20I series.
... MATCH DAY …

After the ODI series concluded with Bangladesh winning the last match in Chattogram, the two teams are now all set to clash in the T20I series. For the hosts, it will be the in-form Shakib leading against the World T20 champions. There will be a few changes in the team for the hosts, as Soumya Sarkar, Mossaek Hossein, and Ebadot Hossein will miss this T20I series. Shanto and Litton Das are expected to open the batting lineup and they will be supported by their skipper, Shakib Al Hasan, Afif Hossain, and Mehidy Hasan in the middle order. There are many promising bowlers in the squad as Shakib leads the attack alongside Nasum Ahmed. The latter will be the key bowler to watch out for. On the other hand, the visitors will be pleased with their performance, and Jos Buttler would like his squad to continue the good work. There will be no Jason Roy or James Vince in the England squad. Ben Duckett is in the squad and the opening duo is likely to be Buttler-Salt followed by Moeen Ali or Malan. Their all-rounders allow for depth in the batting order. Sam Curran can be good with the bat in the lower order and can also deliver breakthroughs alongside Jofra Archer and Chris Jordan, who will be England's key pace attackers. Let's hope for a close contest.
